t: Upgrade your viewing experience with this Full Motion TV wall mount from Ross. Supporting TVs and monitors from 23" to 50" (58-127cm) up to 30kg, this full-motion bracket features a triple-arm design that extending 56-378mm, allowing for smooth tilt, swivel, and reach adjustments offering 13° tilt and 90° swivel for optimal viewing angles. Compatible with VESA patterns from 100x100mm to 200x200mm, with a durable steel construction, and easy slide-on installation.
b: Comes Complete With all Fixtures & Fittings
